TEST(crestApiTest, appendEndpointJoinsWithOneSlash) {
  EXPECT_EQ(
      "https://crest.cern.ch/api-v6.0/tags",
      StringUtils::appendEndpoint("https://crest.cern.ch/api-v6.0", "/tags"));
  EXPECT_EQ(
      "https://crest.cern.ch/api-v6.0/tags",
      StringUtils::appendEndpoint("https://crest.cern.ch/api-v6.0", "tags"));
  EXPECT_EQ(
      "https://crest.cern.ch/api-v6.0/tags",
      StringUtils::appendEndpoint("https://crest.cern.ch/api-v6.0/", "tags"));
}

TEST(crestApiTest, parseUrlExtractsApiPath)

TEST(crestApiTest, parseUrlExtractsApiPath) {
  EXPECT_EQ("/api-v6.0",
            StringUtils::parseUrl("https://crest.cern.ch/api-v6.0").apipath);
  EXPECT_EQ(
      "/api-v6.0",
      StringUtils::parseUrl("https://crest.cern.ch:8080/api-v6.0").apipath);
  EXPECT_EQ(
      "/api/v6/nested",
      StringUtils::parseUrl("https://crest.cern.ch/api/v6/nested").apipath);
}

TEST(crestApiTest, parseUrlRejectsMalformedApiPath) {
  EXPECT_THROW(StringUtils::parseUrl("https://crest.cern.ch/api v6"),
               CrestException);
  EXPECT_THROW(
      StringUtils::parseUrl(std::string_view("https://crest.cern.ch/a\0b", 25)),
      CrestException);
}
